fields.description: The Woods Serenity offers one- and two-bedroom apartments within Sobha Sanctuary. The design places stepped residential forms alongside gardens and shaded pedestrian spaces. Its own collection includes a two-bedroom Type C alongside the other published apartment layouts.

reviewCoverage.identity: Dedicated The Woods Serenity official page and named brochure reviewed; no data transferred from another Woods release.
reviewCoverage.location: Sobha Sanctuary/Al Yufrah setting verified; selected tower and neighbourhood details retained.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own one/two-bedroom types identified independently of current sale-selection mix.
reviewCoverage.areas: Primary web tables and own PDF examples read; printed suite/balcony/total labels retained. Representative named plan sheets visually inspected.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own official amenity list reviewed; nursery and wider shared facilities are planned, with access/delivery unconfirmed.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Current dedicated-page amount distinguished from dated or launch references; no inventory claim adopted.
reviewCoverage.payment: Named secondary aggregate totals 100; own developer documents omit a dated calendar, expressly recorded.
reviewCoverage.handover: Current official catalogue lists 2029; narrower portal quarter is not a contractual guarantee.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own official brochure downloaded and inspected; floor plans are within the 53-page brochure; a separate published pack was not found.

overview: The inspected two-bedroom Type A drawing identifies Tower C and examples on levels 4-10. Its corner position and balcony arrangement differ from the smaller Type B and Type C homes. The individual floor plan provides a more useful comparison than a single marketing size range.
research.locationNote: Sobha locates The Woods Serenity within Sobha Sanctuary in Al Yufrah, with road access through the surrounding Dubailand district. Confirm the selected building, route and outlook rather than treating a general community map as a unit pin.
research.priceNote: Sobha currently advertises AED 1.21m on the dedicated page, subject to inventory. Property Finder retains an older AED 999,000 launch reference. These describe different published price bases; ask for the current unit quotation and complete costs.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% booking, 40% during construction and40% at handover. The official project page and reviewed brochure do not publish dated instalments; the displayed aggregate split is a portal reference requiring developer confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The current Sobha catalogue lists 2029. Secondary references quote Q4 2029; confirm the unit's contractual programme and handover arrangements.

facts.label: Tower-specific example
facts.value: The reviewed Type A plan identifies Tower C, levels 4-10 and C401-C901 examples. Confirm the actual floor and orientation; the diagram does not establish remaining stock.

unresolved: Some portal tables label a 963 sq ft two-bedroom drawing as a one-bedroom layout. The own developer-labelled plan takes precedence.
The displayed payment split is a secondary reference. Obtain the developer-issued dated schedule and final completion terms.
Confirm registered suite/balcony area, parking, final specification, service charges and current availability.
Amenity delivery, access rules and operating costs require confirmation. Photography remains illustrative.
Printed totals are retained: rounded suite and balcony components can differ from the published total by 0.01 sq ft.
